metrics.precision: TP/(TP+FP); undefined if there are no predicted positives
metrics.truth: independent function-entry observations for declared downstream clients
metrics.aggregation: client mean within library, then equal-library mean on an explicitly shared eligible set
metrics.additionalFootprint: saved implementations, recovery helpers and metadata reported separately
metrics.validation: exact complete test signature, source hashes, mapping validity, no conversion errors

noRQ2orRQ3RerunRequiredFor: Recomputing precision from a validated independent truth snapshot

runtimeChangePolicy: A changed Graal/NodeProf implementation requires qualification on all ten libraries and a new frozen run. Do not append three changed-runtime rows to seven old-runtime rows as one controlled experiment.
outputPolicy: New run ID, no overwritten source measurements, preserve failed controls and all stderr/stdout
runPriority: only then separately frozen RQ2-RQ4 if reruns are required
